text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B after a 59.4% gain felt satisfying, but I should decide whether to sell based on my plan and the investment outlook, not just the pleasure of locking in a gain.","Selling Stock C for a smaller gain also reduced my exposure, but I should avoid letting my average cost or fear of losing a gain dictate every decision.","My account fell over the last few periods despite little trading; I should review the portfolio periodically and make deliberate choices rather than assume holding alone is enough."]}
